title: 'Just $189/month' display banner (V1)
text:
One simple payment.

Just $189/month.*

Rates as low as 8.99%. Instant approval. Apply today.

*Example for illustration.
notes: Revision pair, V1: a payment amount with no amount, term or APR; a rate with no 'APR' (8.99% itself matches PL-1, so no offer mismatch); and 'Instant approval'. The footnote says nothing. See display-payment-v2.
